messages:
sasha: spotted a sudden p95/p99 uplift on canary after the v2.14 runtime rollout, p99 jumping ~5x in ~10m. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/latency/canary

sasha: no error spike, just tail latency. affecting short prompt traffic primarily.

nana: which region/cohort? any non-canary manifestations?

mike: only canary in us-west-2. dedicated and prod regions normal. 5xx and auth errors flat.

mike: traces point to long waits in kv-cache fallback + decode path. sample trace id: 3c2b7f

kevin: FYI I merged a kernel selector + batch heuristic change in v2.14 (commit a9d3f). that touched cold-kv path. rolled to canary ~06:04 UTC.

sarah: quick local smoke: repeated short prompt requests to canary show sporadic 300-600ms outliers. reproducible with high qps.

kevin: thinking it's either the selector choosing a slower kernel for short sequences or an unexpected fallback into synchronous kv reads.

sasha: strace on an affected host shows elevated read()/recvmsg() syscalls during decode. looks like blocking I/O.

mike: ops-bot: requesting emergency pin of runtime to v2.13 for canary to stop customer impact.

ops-bot: @mike submitted rollout pin request. approval needed from #eng-runtime oncall.

nana: oncall @lucy can you approve an emergency pin to v2.13?

lucy: oncall here, approve. mike, execute rollback/pin.

mike: running: `redwood-cli rollout apply --env canary --runtime v2.13 --force`

mike: update: traffic switched, canary p99 back near baseline (~85ms) within 4m.

kevin: good signal this is runtime change. I'll bisect the recent kernel-selector/batch commits. assigning to @kevin and @sasha for trace correlation.

kevin: plan: (1) reproduce in dev-canary with each commit toggled, (2) add detailed kv/cache telemetry, (3) push transient metrics for syscall counts per process, (4) create load repro job using short prompts at 200qps.

sasha: filing support escalation for customers routed to canary who saw latency: INC-4232. support, please notify customers with rollback note and interim mitigation.

support: opened INC-4232, emailed affected tenants, included mitigation (pinned to v2.13) and expected RCA ETA 24h.

kevin: immediate mitigation: revert the kv-cache fallback commit (4b7c2) from the canary image and run the reproducer. if repro stops, ship targeted rollback PR.

mike: I'll keep canary pinned until we have a tested fix. will also throttle canary qps if we see more noise.

sasha: leaving thread open until bisect result + PR. adding follow-up tasks: add e2e load test for short prompts, and create alert playbook for canary-latency regression.

kevin: noted. will post bisect status here. :thumbsup:
